newsitem.title: USA: Secret UAW talks with Chrysler, GM - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Secret UAW talks with Chrysler, GM - WSJ.

text.p: The president of the United Auto Workers union met privately Thursday with top executives of General Motors Corp and Chrysler Corp in an effort to elicit the best and quickest deal in the ongoing labor-contract negotiations, the Wall Street Journal reported Friday.

Neither the union nor the companies would confirm the meetings occurred between UAW President Stephen Yokich, John F. Smith Jr, chairman of General Motors, and senior Chrysler labor officials, the Journal said.
The UAW and Ford Motor Co came to terms on a three-year contract last week and is headed for union ratification this weekend.
Neither Chrysler nor GM were immediately available to comment on the article.
